statements.statement: The assessor stated the fiscal 2026 tax levy resulting from the levy limit calculation.
No override was applied in calculating the fiscal 2026 maximum allowable tax levy.
The estimated single tax rate for fiscal 2026 was given, an increase over last year's rate.
The average single family tax bill under the estimated single rate would rise by this amount over last year.

warnings.prediction: Safeguards are needed in the accounting/audit process so that unaccounted charges do not recur.
